title: Bound template-build concurrency and cancel stale CI revisions
problem: Launching one compiler per hosted CPU can exhaust memory once formatting templates grow; stale runs consume the same runner quota.
example: On a runner with many CPUs, make -j2 bounds compiler processes while a newer PR commit cancels the superseded workflow.
design: Set a consistent two-job compile bound and a workflow/PR concurrency key without reducing the compiler matrix.
tradeoffs: Less parallelism may increase wall time. Cancelled stale runs are incomplete evidence, not passing checks.
